Scottsdale Fashion Square: The Ultimate Luxury Shopping Experience

Scottsdale Fashion Square isn't just a mall — it's the Southwest's premier luxury shopping destination. With Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, and hundreds more, a serious shopping day here deserves transportation that matches the experience.

The short answer: book a chauffeured vehicle by the hour and it stays with you. A Luxury SUV is $125/hr (4-hour minimum), so a 4-hour shopping day is $500 before tax. Groups take the Executive Sprinter at $145/hr or the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) at $175/hr; for the full VIP treatment, the Maybach Jet Sprinter is $295/hr.

Why Luxury Transportation for Shopping?

The Practical Case

Parking Reality:
Fashion Square's parking structure is massive and confusing. Finding your car after hours of shopping — often with tired feet and full hands — isn't the triumphant end to your retail therapy.

Bag Management:
When you're buying across multiple stores, carrying bags limits your ability to shop. With a waiting vehicle, you can drop bags off and continue unencumbered.

Weather Consideration:
Arizona summers mean scorching surface temperatures in parking lots. Walking to a distant car in that heat, carrying bags, is genuinely unpleasant.

Time Efficiency:
Curbside drop-off means more time shopping, less time circling for parking.

The Experience Upgrade

Arrival Statement:
Pulling up to Fashion Square's main entrance in a brand-new Maybach Jet Sprinter or Luxury SUV sets a different tone than finding a parking spot in the garage.

A Break Between Stops:
Shopping is exhausting. A 15-minute break in your climate-controlled vehicle with refreshments recharges you for round two.

Private Space:
Try on jewelry, review purchases, make calls — your vehicle is your private lounge.

The Classic Shopping Day

Duration: 4 hours
Vehicle: Luxury SUV
Fare: 4 × $125 = $500 before tax ($540 with tax)

Includes:

  • Pickup from Scottsdale hotel/home
  • Curbside drop-off at Fashion Square
  • The vehicle stays on call (we wait nearby or return)
  • Bag storage between shopping sessions
  • Return transportation when finished

The VIP Shopping Experience

Duration: 6 hours
Vehicle: Maybach Jet Sprinter
Fare: 6 × $295 = $1,770 before tax ($1,912 with tax)

Includes:

  • Everything in the Classic day, plus:
  • Coordination with the personal-stylist appointments you book
  • Refreshments in the vehicle
  • Mid-day lunch transfer
  • Store-to-vehicle bag runs
  • The most refined cabin in our fleet

The Girls' Day Out

Duration: 5 hours
Vehicle: Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax)
Fare: 5 × $175 = $875 before tax ($945 with tax) — about $55 per person with sixteen aboard

Includes:

  • Group pickup from multiple locations
  • Party atmosphere on the ride

Practical Shopping Tips

Best Times to Shop

Weekday Mornings:

  • Stores open at 10 AM
  • Minimal crowds
  • Best personal attention

Saturday Late Morning:

  • Full staff, all stores open
  • Energy and atmosphere
  • More crowded

Avoid:

  • Holiday weekends
  • Saturday afternoons (peak crowds)
  • Sunday mornings (limited hours)

Making the Most of Your Day

Strategy 1: Anchor Exploration
Start with Neiman Marcus or Nordstrom personal shopping. They'll pull options, you try. Less walking, maximum efficiency.

Strategy 2: Boutique Circuit
Hit specific stores on your list first (while feet are fresh), then browse.

Strategy 3: Break Strategically
Take a mid-day break in your vehicle or at a Fashion Square restaurant. Rested shoppers make better decisions.
